title: Categorical ontology fingerprint contract
family_rule: A family is one exact, complete categorical fingerprint. Family equality is componentwise equality; no graph merge, code normalization, or reviewer judgement may merge unequal fingerprints.
primary_parent_rule: For a multi-parent proposal, the primary parent is the first candidate ID in the recorded parent_ids list. All parent IDs remain provenance. The eight trajectory metrics use only this primary parent.

campaign_schema_policy.extension_rule: When a reviewed source contains a mechanism that lacks a category value, add a precise value and its definition to this campaign registry. When it contains an uncovered component, add that component and assign absent to every earlier candidate that does not instantiate it. Every component must define scope, exclusions, absence and numeric invariants; each canonical category needs a definition. Aliases are role scoped. Extensions require equivalence and distinction regression cases.
campaign_schema_policy.reprojection_rule: Every extension creates a new schema revision. Before any metric is published, every candidate in that campaign is reclassified against the current complete registry and all family and trajectory metrics are recomputed from the first proposal.
campaign_schema_policy.publication_rule: A published campaign output names the registry revision and embeds its complete schema snapshot. Rows from different registry revisions are never combined in one family or metric calculation.
campaign_schema_policy.unknown_rule: An undeclared value is a schema-extension request, never a completed fingerprint value and never a family.
